entries.text: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL-1.0): the `osm-ru`, `osm-in`, `osm-id`, `osm-ng`, `osm-pk`, `osm-vn` and `osm-bd` training extracts taken from the 2026-10-02 Geofabrik extracts (2,282,782 rows in corpus v0.7.1-osm-exposure), plus the `rendered-pk-register` and `rendered-bd-register` training extracts rendered from OSM tuples. The v7.2.0 epoch audit emits 103,322 of 1,000,000 rows from the seven `osm-*` sources and 15,609 from the two registers. The `spliced-sub-venue` training extract also carries OpenStreetMap venue and sub-venue names, taken from the 2026-08 Geofabrik extracts of Great Britain, France, Germany and Spain, in 73,039 of its 120,000 rows; the epoch audit emits 52,806 rows from that source. © OpenStreetMap contributors, https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright. The extracts are Derivative Databases under ODbL 1.0 and the effective training manifest packages/corpus/data/training-manifests/v0.7.2-address-systems.effective.json records what reached the trainer. The extracts are published under ODbL 1.0 at https://huggingface.co/datasets/sister-software/mailwoman-osm-training-extract.

HM Land Registry — Price Paid Data (OGL v3.0): the `synth-gb-v1` training extract (800,000 rows) NEW in 6.7.0. Crown copyright, attribution required. The GB placetype-pair index is built from the same source and ships in `neural-weights-en-gb`, whose own card carries its attribution.
LINZ-derived OpenAddresses NZ (CC-BY 4.0): the `synth-nz-v2` training extract (800,000 rows) NEW in 6.7.0.
OpenAddresses ES tuples (CC-BY per OA source): the `synth-es-pedania-v1` training extract (800,000 rows, below-municipio pedanía place names) NEW in 6.7.0.

BAN — Base Adresse Nationale (DINUM / IGN, Licence Ouverte 2.0): the `synth-fr-lieudit-v1` training extract (`nom_ld` lieu-dit field) NEW in 6.7.0, additional to the existing `synth-fr-fragment` extract (144,865 rows, 6.4.0).

Overture Maps Foundation — Addresses theme (per-country register license; Overture declares no identifier of its own for this theme, so the terms are the upstream register's): the `overture-latam` CA/MX training extract (456,230 rows, 6.6.0). Attribution-only, not share-alike. Read 2026-09-25 from https://docs.overturemaps.org/attribution/.
OpenAddresses CZ — ČÚZK RÚIAN (CC-BY 4.0): tokenizer-splice training text + the oa-cz coord eval sets
OpenAddresses PL — GUGiK / PRG (public, BDOT-derived): tokenizer-splice training text + the oa-pl coord eval sets
OpenAddresses SK — MINV/ZBGIS (CC-0/CC-BY per OA source): oa-sk coord eval set (free-rider validation)
OpenAddresses SI — GURS (CC-BY per OA source): oa-si coord eval set (free-rider validation)
See THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md for the standing OpenAddresses / GeoNames / WOF attribution.

effective_training_sources reads one epoch of corpus-python/src/mailwoman_train/configs/v7.2.0-address-systems-60k.yaml at seed 43. A training run draws a different sample per epoch, so the source set it names is what one audited epoch drew rather than the union over every epoch the model saw.
